howToExport: In the IBKR Portal, open the reports area and choose Statements → Activity.
Pick the period (monthly, yearly or custom dates) and CSV as the format.
Run and download the statement, then drop it above; choose a section in the Section menu.
knownQuirks: Every row starts with its section name and Header or Data, so one CSV holds dozens of tables with different columns; Excel shows it as one jagged sheet.
Trades include SubTotal and Total rows plus ClosedLot detail rows under closing trades. Summing Proceeds without removing them double-counts; the preset drops all three.
Trade times are written as «2024-01-15, 10:30:01», with a comma inside the date, which Excel treats as text; the preset keeps the date only.
Numbers mix integers and decimals from row to row; they're written uniformly so Excel sums and pivots work.

columnMapping.transformationNote: The first two columns of every row are removed
Also used for the in/out totals
